note: Integer weights applied as value × weight / 1000 to the solver metrics (FR-082). Class thresholds are per band because scores grow with level scale. Bands 11–100 were calibrated by trial generation of the draft picture library (Normal levels score about 950–1600, tuned levels reach about 3000); later bands are extrapolated. Recalibrate after playtests. Every band from L11 carries big thresholds for its 22×28 boards (spec 001 FR-008 as amended on 2026-10-07: from L11 a board may be any size from 14×16 to 22×28); a board between 288 and 616 cells takes the band’s own thresholds and its big ones in proportion to its cells (BandGuidelines.ThresholdsFor). They come from trial generation on 22×28 pictures of the library with each band’s profile, two levels a band: 8 Normal levels and the best score the tray tuner reached on 60 Super Hard candidates (2026-10-07). The Normal levels scored 1995–2303 in band 11–25 and 2070–3080 in the later bands; the tuned candidates reached 2317 at the median in band 11–25 (90th percentile 2701) and 2750–2900 in the later bands (90th percentile 3150–3840). So Hard starts above nearly every Normal level and about one tuned candidate in three reaches it, and Super Hard starts at least 350 above Hard (a tuner step can be about 150–300, so it lands inside the Hard range) where one candidate in seven to ten reaches it, which leaves a Super Hard level without a candidate in 30 about once in 25 to 1000 levels. The big thresholds the old milestone levels had (3800–3900 and 4600–4700) are out of reach on these profiles. Kept unchanged on 2026-10-06 after the first generation on the regular boards of 224–288 cells (the owner): the tuned scores are bimodal on levels that mix mechanics (the rejected Super Hard candidates of L21 stayed at 1380–1776 and the accepted one reached 3327; L1001 reached 3437), so a lower Super Hard minimum would not make them pass more often, while a practice level, one mechanic alone, tops out at about 2550 (L151, 119 candidates: median 2018, 90th percentile 2323, none over 2549, against its band’s 3100), below any minimum that leaves the Hard range intact. Practice levels are therefore never Super Hard: the schedule moves such a Super Hard to the next free level (spec 001 FR-059 as amended). The Daily Challenge's thresholds (2026-10-07, the owner's 22×28 boards in four Normal, two Hard and one Super Hard a week) come from trial generation on the 24 big pictures of 22×28 at the L50 unlocks: Normal levels scored 2135–3576 (12), and the best score the tray tuner reached on 718 Hard and Super Hard candidates was 2760 at the median, 3477 at the 90th percentile, 3702 at the 95th and 4544 at most (the big bands' 4600 is out of reach). So Hard starts at 3150 and Super Hard at 3500: about one candidate in eight reaches Hard and one in eleven Super Hard, with the icons board's peak of 3–4 slots.
